units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 10:23">Targ. Prov. X, 23</cite> <he>עביר עביר׳</he> (not <he>עביד עביד׳</he>).

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 23:15">Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 24:1">XXIV, 1</cite> <he>עֲבֵירַת פתגם</he> (h. text <he>ערות דבר</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00054"><he>עֲבֵירָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00050"><he>עֲבֵירָן</he></cite>.
Targ. Job IV, 4 Ms. (ed. Lag. עבירה sing., hebraism; ed. Wil. עֲבֵירָא; oth. ed. עבידתא, incorr.).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 35:25">Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 25</cite>; a. e.—Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ bot. [read:] <he>א״ל חמש עבירן האי גוברא עביד בכל יום</he> he said to him, five sins does this man (I) commit every day.
